verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say CLI telemetry is optional. Users can opt out with `supabase telemetry disable` (and check it with `status`), set `SUPABASE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`, or rely on the respected `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` convention, which suits scripted and agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: evidence of tracking opt-out for the hosted Dashboard/Studio and MCP server, independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Participating in this program is optional, and you can opt out at any time... You can disable telemetry by running: `supabase telemetry disable`
You can also opt out using the `SUPABASE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` environment variable. The broader `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` convention is also respected.
